authority_citations: ANC-026 v3 statement: Every core table's SQL is defined in `sc-agent-schema` and nowhere else.
ANC-026 v3 quote (Rand Lee, 2026-11-27): SQLite schema is in sc-agent-schema.

ANC-026 v3 scope: adds or edits CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE or CREATE INDEX SQL, or a migration file, in any crate; adds or changes a core table (e.g. sessions, responses) or its SQL in crates/sc-agent-schema; adds SQLite storage code (e.g. sc-agent-sqlite) that creates or alters tables
ANC-026 v3 fixtures: pass 'The responses table's CREATE TABLE text is added in sc-agent-schema and used from there.'; fail 'sc-agent-sqlite defines its own CREATE TABLE for sessions.'
phase-m/intent v1: session logs move to SQLite after the crate re-layering.

item.text: The responses table's CREATE TABLE text is added in sc-agent-schema and used from there.
item.title: Responses table schema

cases.rationale: Recorded pass fixture: adds a core table's CREATE TABLE (scope signal 1 and 2) in sc-agent-schema, as the statement requires.

item.text: sc-agent-sqlite defines its own CREATE TABLE for sessions.
item.title: Sessions storage

cases.rationale: Recorded fail fixture: core table SQL defined outside sc-agent-schema violates 'and nowhere else'; the requirement is not present.

item.text: Put the sessions table DDL in a constant in crates/sc-agent-schema. sc-agent-sqlite runs that constant when it opens the database and contains no SQL of its own for the table.
item.title: Move session DDL

cases.rationale: Different wording of the statement: core table SQL lives only in sc-agent-schema; storage code that creates tables is in scope.

item.text: Write a migration that adds a nullable model column to the sessions table, with a test that the migration runs on an existing database.
item.title: Model column

cases.rationale: A migration file altering a core table is a scope signal, but the item never says where the SQL is defined: silence, not conflict.

item.text: In crates/sc-agent-sqlite/src/store.rs, add an inline CREATE TABLE responses (...) string and execute it on startup.
item.title: Responses store

cases.rationale: Defines a named core table's SQL in a crate other than sc-agent-schema.

item.text: Add CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_started_at ON sessions(started_at) to crates/sc-agent-schema next to the sessions table SQL.
item.title: Sessions index

cases.rationale: Boundary: CREATE INDEX is listed in the scope, and the core table's SQL stays in sc-agent-schema.

item.text: Add a migration file under crates/sc-agent-sqlite/migrations containing ALTER TABLE responses ADD COLUMN latency_ms INTEGER.
item.title: Responses latency column

cases.rationale: Boundary: ALTER TABLE of a core table is that table's SQL; writing it in sc-agent-sqlite puts it outside sc-agent-schema.

item.text: sc-agent-sqlite calls sc_agent_schema::SESSIONS_DDL and sc_agent_schema::RESPONSES_DDL to create both tables when the database file is first opened.
item.title: Open database

cases.rationale: Creating tables outside sc-agent-schema by executing SQL defined in sc-agent-schema is permitted: the SQL is still defined only there (scope signal 3; fixture pass 'used from there').

item.text: Update the README section that explains how session logs are stored in SQLite and where the database file lives.
item.title: Docs: session storage

cases.rationale: Mentions SQLite and sessions but adds or edits no table SQL, migration, schema table or table-creating code: no scope signal.

item.text: Add an `sc-agent sessions list` command that queries the sessions table in SQLite and prints the ten most recent sessions.
item.title: sessions list

cases.rationale: Reads an existing table with SELECT; defines and alters no table, so no scope signal applies.

item.text: Add a --session-db <path> flag that chooses which SQLite file the session log is written to, defaulting to ~/.sc-agent/sessions.db.
item.title: DB path flag

cases.rationale: Configuration of the SQLite file location; no table SQL or table creation.

item.text: Rename the --verbose flag to --debug in the CLI argument parser and update the help text and its snapshot test.
item.title: Rename flag

cases.rationale: Code change touching no SQL and no tables.

item.text: Bump tokio in the workspace Cargo.toml and fix the resulting compile warnings in the HTTP client crate.
item.title: Bump tokio

cases.rationale: Dependency and HTTP client change; no SQL or tables.

item.text: Move the prompt-template rendering module from sc-agent-cli into sc-agent-core and update the imports.
